findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no ACL set restricting access, and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is present, allowing potential unauthenticated read/write access to objects such as customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, so objects stored in this bucket (including customer-master.xlsx) are stored unencrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing potentially sensitive customer records to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this financials bucket, leaving potentially sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so objects in the operations bucket are stored unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so objects in the data-science bucket are stored unencrypted at rest despite having logging and versioning enabled.
